A: the window has a matte stone wall, wood frames with modest grain, and a single glossy candle accent, so a better gloss mix.

pairs.difference: B: the marble lion and plinth carry realistic grey veining and crack lines, and the mane is carved into many fine strands, a photoreal stone texture. A: the snorkel is smooth translucent plastic with one broad reflection.
pairs.fix: lion statue as smooth soft white stone, no veins or cracks, mane as a few large rounded locks

pattern: Generated cards give themselves away through surface texture that is too busy or realistic for the style. The usual signs are weathered wood with chipped paint and nail heads, pitted or speckled iron and stone, marble veining, and fine repeated fields: perforation dots, grass blades, cobblestones, hundreds of leaves. Some also have uniform lacquer gloss over the whole object. Real cards use broad smooth parts, quiet fine grain, and a mix of matte and shiny.
